_comment: ACE-Step v1 3.5B - the FULL music model, as opposed to the v1.5 turbo used by workflow 06. Turbo is built for speed at cfg 1.0 and ~20 steps; this is the quality option. CheckpointLoaderSimple bundles model + clip + vae, so the graph is much simpler than the 1.5 one.
_notes: Real classifier-free guidance here: cfg 1.0 disables guidance entirely, which means the tags barely steer the render. Use cfg 4-7.
Instrumental only - leave lyrics empty. Do not paste lyrics you do not own.
Cost scales with steps; audio latents are small so even 100 steps is seconds, not minutes.
